name: Counseling
description: The graduate degree that leads to licensure as a mental health counselor, marriage and family therapist or school counselor in Florida. ⚠⚠⚠ It is not a psychology degree and it is mostly not in a psychology department: 285 of Florida's roughly 372 counselling master's seats sit under COUNSELOR EDUCATION, which is an education code. ⚠⚠ Eight Florida public institutions, all universities — against 27 state colleges teaching undergraduate psychology.
degreesNote: ⚠⚠⚠ THE LMHC MASTER'S IS NEARLY TWICE A NORMAL MASTER'S. Section 491.005(4), F.S. requires a minimum of an earned master's degree from a mental health counseling programme accredited by CACREP consisting of at least 60 SEMESTER HOURS, including 33 semester hours of graduate coursework covering a minimum of 3 semester hours in EACH of eleven named content areas: counseling theories and practice; human growth and development; diagnosis and treatment of psychopathology; human sexuality; group theories and practice; individual evaluation and assessment; career and lifestyle assessment; research and program evaluation; social and cultural foundations; substance abuse; and legal, ethical and professional standards. ⚠⚠ Plus at least 700 hours of university-sponsored supervised clinical practicum, internship or field experience, of which at least 280 hours must be DIRECT CLIENT SERVICES — and then at least 2 years of post-master's clinical experience supervised by a licensed mental health counselor. ⚠ Most master's degrees are 30 to 36 hours. Budget for 60, and for two more years after it. ⚠⚠⚠ LOOK IN THE COLLEGE OF EDUCATION, NOT PSYCHOLOGY. Florida's counselling master's degrees are coded 285 under Counselor Education (13.1101) at 8 institutions, 57 under Mental Health Counseling (51.1508) at just 2, and 30 under Marriage and Family Therapy (51.1505) at 4. ⚠ A psychology major hunting for a graduate counselling programme inside a psychology department will mostly not find one. The course prefix tells the same story: MHS is carried by 9 Florida public universities and exactly ONE state college. ⚠ This site's CIP tree does not yet carry 51.15, so this programme claims the counselor education code alone; the other two are named here so the seats are visible.

cips.note: Counselor Education/School Counseling and Guidance Services — 8 Florida public institutions and 383 credentials in 2023: 285 master's, 60 post-master's certificates, 18 postbaccalaureate certificates, 20 research doctorates. UCF 69 master's, FSU 54, FAU 50, FIU 41, FGCU 29, UF 12. ⚠ An EDUCATION code, which is where most Florida counselling preparation actually sits.

related.note: ⚠⚠⚠ The feeder, and the ratio is the thing to see before choosing a major. Florida awards 6,228 psychology BACHELOR'S a year at 10 universities and 27 state colleges teach the prefix — against roughly 372 counselling master's seats. ⚠ About seventeen psychology graduates for every counselling master's place, and the licence needs the master's.

⚠⚠ The adjacent licence, regulated by the SAME Florida chapter (491) and often the better-paid route. Social workers overall earn $61,780 against mental health counselors' $59,350, healthcare social workers $67,880, and the macro track $71,900. ⚠ The MSW is 61 credit hours at FSU against the LMHC's statutory 60 — comparable length, wider exit.

⚠ Named because behavioural health at population scale — prevention, substance use programmes, community mental health planning — is public health work, and the two fields share employers in county health departments and community mental health centres.

⚠⚠ Named because the counselling degree lives in the college of education, and school counselling is the branch of it Florida numbers at 13.1101 alongside counselor education generally. ⚠ A school counsellor route runs through certification as well as licensure, which is a different set of requirements from the LMHC.

⚠ Shared territory rather than a route: substance abuse and behavioural disorder counselling is heavily employed in drug courts, corrections and diversion programmes. ⚠⚠ A criminal justice degree earns nothing toward the LMHC, but the employment overlap is real and worth knowing about.
